# TWIN-SUPPLY-CHAIN-002

This is the second, structurally distinct Kernel v0.8 fixture.  It models
software-supply-chain package origin rather than endpoint lateral movement.
Its frozen result domain has three candidates and its formal model has two
auxiliary variables plus an explicit three-world legality table.

The fixture exercises Checker, MinDiff, counterexample assembly,
distinguishing-action selection, deterministic execution, Firewall admission,
audited ADMIT, recertification, and system-state derivation.  It uses no
ground truth, hidden recoverable IDs, stochastic observation, Planner, LLM,
training, Part B, or external connector.

The checked-in approval manifest is exact-hash `APPROVED` by the Project05
repository owner. This fixture still does not itself grant a level-complete
certificate, `CERTIFIED_STOP`, A16 Go, push, or PR authority.
